description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RTX is an aerospace and defense research company developing advances in areas such as machine language translation and quantum cryptography. The Research Software Engineer I will work on AI-based planning and scheduling, compiler and operating-system capabilities, prototype software development, user feedback integration, and practical solutions to complex problems.
Research software engineer developing AI planning, compiler, and OS prototypes for command-and-control systems

Responsibilities:
• Work with a small team on cutting-edge research and development projects, focusing on AI based planning and scheduling (e.g., in the context of joint all domain command and control), novel compiler (e.g., LLVM passes) and/or OS-related (e.g., kernel modules, userland services) capability development
• Design and develop prototype software using the latest open-source technologies
• Receive and incorporate feedback from end users, field tests, and exercises
• Explore technical possibilities collaboratively with motivated, world class colleagues
• Deliver practical solutions to complex problems

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required.​ U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
• BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or STEM major obtained by start date
• Experience with Java and/or C, Linux, basic Networking, and Cloud Integration
• Experience with distributed systems, middleware, and AI

Preferred:
• Creative problem solving and experimental design
• Good oral and written communication skills
• Work in a self-directed manner as part of a team
